question: Does one fixed source-only semantic attention gate add held-block representation capacity to the same nine explicit colour curves beyond global, luminance and spatially shifted gates on paired FiveK digital-retouch controls?

research_basis.paper: Zhang, PrismNet: Semantic-Aware Image Enhancement via Vision Transformer and Zero-Cost Gating, CVPR Findings 2026
research_basis.paper_code_status: The paper provides no code URL or checkpoint identity; this is a clean-room mechanism discriminator, not an official reproduction.
research_basis.borrowed_idea_only: predict an explicit nine-curve global residual and multiply that residual by a source-derived semantic gate
research_basis.clean_room_difference: fixed local DINOv2-S CLS-to-patch attention; no fine-tuning, sparse ParamHead, CNN branch, learned gate, paper weights, paper data, LPIPS curriculum or final-RGB network

population.row_selection: lexicographically first pair_id within each exact development camera_model group
population.role: paired digital-retouch representation-capacity control; not film or stock evidence

semantic_gate.input: encoded sRGB resized to 224x224 then ImageNet normalized

explicit_operator.application: source plus gate times summed curve residual followed by one analytical per-pixel dose

controls.global_gate: all ones with the exact same nine curves, fit mask, ridge, bounds and analytical dose
controls.luminance_gate: per-image z-scored encoded-sRGB luminance followed by sigmoid
controls.shifted_semantic_gate: semantic gate circularly shifted by half height and half width before fitting

branch_rules.all_gates_pass: freeze the representation and open one separately frozen group-held source-only curve-parameter predictor; do not promote from this target-informed capacity leaf
branch_rules.any_gate_fails: close the exact fixed-attention semantic-gate mechanism without changing model, attention layer, gate normalization, curve knots, controls, split or thresholds
branch_rules.visual_review: forbidden in this target-informed representation-capacity leaf

claim_ceiling: Development-only held-block representation-capacity evidence for one fixed source-only semantic gate and explicit curves on paired FiveK digital-retouch controls; not an official PrismNet reproduction, deployable predictor, film response, stock identity, calibration, preference or product result.
